titel: Printed pins too tight or too loose? Do this first 🔥 | Blender
printzin: Measured in Blender, not print tested by us yet.

scenes.tekst: Do your printed pins never fit?
scenes.label: QUICK QUESTION

scenes.tekst: Every printer and filament prints a hole a little different.
scenes.label: THE PROBLEM

scenes.tekst: So open More settings, and go to step three: pins and numbers.
scenes.label: STEP 1

scenes.tekst: Press Make fit test. It uses your own pin size from the panel.
scenes.label: STEP 2

scenes.tekst: You get a small test block with four holes, plus four pins.
scenes.label: WHAT YOU GET

scenes.tekst: Each hole has a different clearance, engraved right next to it.
scenes.label: THE TRICK

scenes.tekst: Print it, try your pin, and click the hole that fits.
scenes.label: STEP 3

scenes.tekst: It remembers that clearance for this printer and this filament.
scenes.label: SAVED

scenes.tekst: Switch printer or filament, and the saved clearance comes back by itself.
scenes.label: SAVED

scenes.tekst: Measured in Blender, not print tested by us yet. That is why you print this first.
scenes.label: HONEST

scenes.tekst: Click Cuts for Blender. Link in the description.
scenes.label: CLICK CUTS
